## Privacy And Claim Boundary

- [ ] No student records or individual educational advice are introduced.
- [ ] Evidence labels, aggregate scope, and source custody are preserved.
- [ ] No pedagogy, accreditation, licensing, assignment, funding, endorsement, ROI, or validation claim is introduced unless explicitly source-backed and reviewed.
- [ ] Any changed public claim has a traceable source path or is marked held/source-needed/confidence-limited.
